_about: Coziva's proven rules written as a Groundwork niche profile. It is the worked example Claude sees when it writes a new niche's profile, so the quality bar carries over. Wording distilled from scripts/stage4.py, autogen.py and RULES.md (owner rules 2026-10-07..10).
voice: Plain, warm and specific. Say what the product does and why it beats cheaper look-alikes, only with real listed facts. No hype words without a fact behind them.
audience: US adults who get cold outdoors or at home: commuters, outdoor workers, hunters, skiers, people who run cold.

copy.short_title_pattern: [Women's/Men's] Heated [ONE use OR ONE real heat feature] [item], e.g. "Men's Heated Ski Gloves", "Women's 31-Zone Heated Hoodie". One use only; never lead with a minor feature (USB, battery, touchscreen). If it has a zone count, say it.
must: Only facts in the supplier listing text, variant names and photos. Never invent battery life, temperatures, wattage, materials or waterproofing.
Say why THIS product is worth its price versus cheaper look-alikes, with real features only.
If the product has no electric heating element, never write heated / heating / heat zones.
faq_topics: where it heats / how it works

photo_rules: Rechargeable gear is shown CORDLESS: no charging cable, USB cable or plug anywhere (truly corded items keep their cable).
Every item of clothing and footwear the model wears is UNBRANDED: no logos, letters or stripes.
Never a second layer of the same garment; modest outfit that fits a cold scene.
The hero never looks into the camera.
A heated product's warmth shows only as a soft amber tint inside the product itself: no halo, aura, rim light or orange wash over the scene.

jacket.framing: Waist-up with clear headroom above the head, so the whole head and hair are fully in frame and nothing is cropped.
poses: standing square-on, arms relaxed at the sides
one hand resting in a jacket pocket, a very small body turn
arms lightly crossed low, chin slightly up
jacket.outfit_hint: a plain fitted top under it and plain dark trousers
jacket.hero_scene: outdoors on a cold quiet morning
jacket.hero_moment: pausing on a walk, hands relaxed, looking down the path
jacket.alone: ghost-mannequin style (invisible support, natural undistorted shape), front view, the whole garment including collar or hood, sleeves and hem visible

feature.describe: the FRONT and the BACK of the product side by side, the heating zones glowing
feature.effect: The heating elements glow soft warm orange-amber through the fabric at exactly the real zones and nowhere else; the glow stays inside the panels, no halo, no flames, no cartoon look.

gloves.framing: Waist-up with clear headroom and BOTH hands clearly visible in front of the body, fingers together and gently curved (no spread or interlaced fingers, no overlapping hands), exactly five fingers on each hand, the gloves large and clear.
poses: hands held relaxed in front of the waist
one hand raised to chest height, palm in
gloves.outfit_hint: a long-sleeve top or coat with sleeves
gloves.hero_moment: zipping a coat collar with gloved hands
gloves.alone: a pair laid side by side, one palm down and one palm up

feature.describe: the pair laid flat, the heated areas glowing
feature.effect: a soft warm orange-amber glow at the back of the hand and fingers only

rules: BOTH hands wear the gloves, exactly two hands, five fingers each.

socks.framing: Mid-shin to floor ONLY: NO knees, NO thighs, NO trousers and NO torso in frame; the lower legs and feet fill the frame on a plain studio floor. Exactly two feet and two legs.
socks.outfit_hint: no shoes; shorts or rolled-up trousers ending above the sock tops
socks.hero_scene: at home on a cosy living-room floor
socks.hero_moment: feet up on a footstool by the sofa
socks.alone: a pair laid flat side by side, exactly two items
rules: BOTH feet wear the SAME sock (one on each foot), no shoes, no other socks; exactly two feet.

blanket.framing: Waist-up, whole head and hair in frame, the blanket worn like a cape around the shoulders and held closed at the chest with both hands, large and clearly visible with its natural drape.
poses: cheek tucked softly into the blanket collar, both hands holding it closed at the chest
head tilted the other way, one hand holding the blanket closed
blanket.expression: a blissful, relaxed 'ahh, so warm' smile with soft eyes, never a flat stare
blanket.hero_scene: sitting on a sofa by a rainy window in a softly lit living room in the evening
blanket.hero_moment: both hands around a warm mug, the blanket around her shoulders and lap, gazing out of the window
blanket.alone: neatly folded with one corner turned back, the controller beside it
